key: VICTORIA: I guess this computer links up to the exit?
en: VICTORIA: I guess this computer links up to the exit?
ja: ヴィクトリア: このコンピュータが出口につながってるのかな?
うーん…

key: You've seen a couple of these already, haven't you?
en: You've seen a couple of these already, haven't you?
ja: もういくつか、これと似たようなの見てきたよね?

key: Can I trust you know what you're doing?
en: Can I trust you know what you're doing?
ja: 任せて大丈夫かな?

key: I'll do my best to manage the computer if you can handle the rest.
en: I'll do my best to manage the computer if you can handle the rest.
ja: 残りをあなたに任せられるなら、コンピュータの方は頑張ってみる。

key: Like, I can see the list of clues here...
en: Like, I can see the list of clues here...
ja: ほら、ここに手がかりのリストが見える…

key: Let me know if you want me to go over anything?
en: Let me know if you want me to go over anything?
ja: 何か確認したいことがあったら言ってね?
ヴィクトリア: わたしに何ができる?
ヴィクトリア: よし、見てみよう!
ヴィクトリア: うわ、量が多いね。

key: Just let me know if you need to go over it again, okay?
en: Just let me know if you need to go over it again, okay?
ja: もう一回確認したくなったら言ってね?
ヴィクトリア: 確認する? ああ、わかった。
ヴィクトリア: うまくいった、のかな?

key: Thanks for helping with that! That was pretty overwhelming.
en: Thanks for helping with that! That was pretty overwhelming.
ja: 手伝ってくれてありがとう! かなり大変だったよ。
さあ、先に進もう!

key: I'm sure we'll find an exit or something soon!
en: I'm sure we'll find an exit or something soon!
ja: きっとすぐに出口とか見つかるはず!
ヴィクトリア: うーん…
違うのかな?

key: The program doesn't exactly give a lot of feedback, but there's no change, so...
en: The program doesn't exactly give a lot of feedback, but there's no change, so...
ja: プログラムはあんまり反応を返してくれないけど、変化がないってことは…

key: Mm, I guess it would be really important to be able to write this stuff down.
en: Mm, I guess it would be really important to be able to write this stuff down.
ja: うーん、こういうのはメモしておくのが大事だよね、きっと。

key: If you have a grid, I'm sure you could mark off which options you've ruled out.
en: If you have a grid, I'm sure you could mark off which options you've ruled out.
ja: 表があれば、除外した選択肢に印をつけられそうだけど。

key: But then how to do that...
en: But then how to do that...
ja: でも、どうやってやればいいんだろう…

key: I guess you have to look for the subleties?
en: I guess you have to look for the subleties?
ja: 細かい部分に注目しなきゃいけないのかな?

key: Like if we know that the gem with "Difficult" Foliation is smaller than Emerald, that also means it's not Emerald.
en: Like if we know that the gem with "Difficult" Foliation is smaller than Emerald, that also means it's not Emerald.
ja: たとえば、片理が「困難」の宝石がエメラルドより小さいってわかってれば、それがエメラルドじゃないってこともわかる。

key: Maybe that narrows it down enough?
en: Maybe that narrows it down enough?
ja: それで十分絞り込めるのかな?
これ、ちゃんと解けるんだよね?
うん…
ヴィクトリア: あ、説明? わかった!

key: So basically, we need to use the clues to figure out all of the qualities of these four crystals.
en: So basically, we need to use the clues to figure out all of the qualities of these four crystals.
ja: つまり基本的には、手がかりを使ってこの4つの結晶の性質を全部突き止めなきゃいけないの。

key: Once we know each of their traits, the blocks in the middle of the area can be moved in line with the screens above to select which has which.
en: Once we know each of their traits, the blocks in the middle of the area can be moved in line with the screens above to select which has which.
ja: それぞれの特徴がわかったら、真ん中にあるブロックを、上の画面に合わせて動かして、どれがどれかを選べるんだって。

key: So if the Emerald gem had a "Silky" Luster we'd push the green block in front of the screen that says "Silky".
en: So if the Emerald gem had a "Silky" Luster we'd push the green block in front of the screen that says "Silky".
ja: つまり、エメラルドの光沢が「絹糸状」だったら、緑のブロックを「絹糸状」って書かれた画面の前に押すの。

key: Once everything's in place, we can check it against the data the system expects.
en: Once everything's in place, we can check it against the data the system expects.
ja: 全部そろったら、システムが期待してるデータと照合できる。

key: I'll handle that, so just let me know.
en: I'll handle that, so just let me know.
ja: そっちはわたしがやるから、教えてね。
…だいたいこんな感じ。

key: Is that enough to go on?
en: Is that enough to go on?
ja: これで大丈夫そう?
ティタニア: はぁ。
これは――

key: This has got to be the single worst data-handling system in the entire world.
en: This has got to be the single worst data-handling system in the entire world.
ja: これは間違いなく、世界一最悪なデータ管理システムね。
もうわかってるでしょ?

key: I am sincerely beside myself in trying to cope with the fact that not only did someone voluntarily choose to create a system like this,
en: I am sincerely beside myself in trying to cope with the fact that not only did someone voluntarily choose to create a system like this,
ja: 誰かが自らこんなシステムを作ろうと決めたという事実だけでも、正直理解に苦しむのに、

key: But they apparently had the technical ability to do so while lacking the common sense to think about all of the blindingly glaring flaws involved with it.
en: But they apparently had the technical ability to do so while lacking the common sense to think about all of the blindingly glaring flaws involved with it.
ja: それを作る技術力がありながら、あからさまな欠陥の数々に気づく常識がなかったっていうんだから。
さっさと片付けましょう。
ティタニア: 何?

key: TITANIA: "Clues" is a generous choice of word.
en: TITANIA: "Clues" is a generous choice of word.
ja: ティタニア: 「手がかり」なんて、ずいぶん甘い言い方ね。
でも、これよ。
ティタニア: …

key: Somebody, somewhere, decided that this was a good idea.
en: Somebody, somewhere, decided that this was a good idea.
ja: どこかの誰かが、これをいい考えだと思ったのよね。

key: Even now, that person could still be out there.
en: Even now, that person could still be out there.
ja: 今もどこかで生きてるかもしれない。
ティタニア: 祈るしかないわね。
ティタニア: …やっと。

key: Let's go; if I spend another minute around this disaster, it might not survive in one piece.
en: Let's go; if I spend another minute around this disaster, it might not survive in one piece.
ja: 行きましょう。この大惨事の周りにこれ以上いたら、原形をとどめてられないかも。

key: TITANIA: And yet, this is a lawless and godless world.
en: TITANIA: And yet, this is a lawless and godless world.
ja: ティタニア: それでも、これは法もなければ神もない世界。

key: We mere mortals are doomed to eternally suffer before the might of an endlessly-obfuscated interface.
en: We mere mortals are doomed to eternally suffer before the might of an endlessly-obfuscated interface.
ja: あたしたち凡人は、永遠に難解なインターフェースの前で苦しみ続ける運命にあるのよ。

key: Truly this is a fate that could rival death.
en: Truly this is a fate that could rival death.
ja: 本当に、死に匹敵する運命ね。

key: Anyway, if you're having trouble, write stuff down.
en: Anyway, if you're having trouble, write stuff down.
ja: とにかく、行き詰まったらメモしなさい。

key: Helps me, at least until someone goes and reads it.
en: Helps me, at least until someone goes and reads it.
ja: 誰かに読まれるまでは、あたしの助けになるから。
それと、逆から考えるヒントも探すこと。

key: If you know that the "Difficult" gem is smaller than Emerald, then you also know that it's not Emerald.
en: If you know that the "Difficult" gem is smaller than Emerald, then you also know that it's not Emerald.
ja: 「困難」の宝石がエメラルドより小さいとわかってるなら、それがエメラルドじゃないこともわかる。

key: This is solvable; it's just really stupid.
en: This is solvable; it's just really stupid.
ja: 解けるには解けるけど、本当にばかげてる。
ティタニア: ええ、そうね。

key: The system has a broken dataset and we need to figure out the details of the crystals it was analyzing and re-input the correct set.
en: The system has a broken dataset and we need to figure out the details of the crystals it was analyzing and re-input the correct set.
ja: このシステムはデータセットが壊れていて、分析していた結晶の詳細を突き止めて、正しいデータを入力し直す必要がある。

key: The way doesn't open until we do, which I'm beginning to suspect was deliberate on the part of the employer to reduce turnover.
en: The way doesn't open until we do, which I'm beginning to suspect was deliberate on the part of the employer to reduce turnover.
ja: それをやるまで道は開かない。雇い主が離職率を下げるためにわざとこうしたんじゃないかって、疑いたくなってきたわ。

key: Most of the work is figuring out the set, but once it's known, it has to be input to the system,
en: Most of the work is figuring out the set, but once it's known, it has to be input to the system,
ja: 作業のほとんどはデータセットを突き止めることだけど、わかったらシステムに入力しなきゃいけない、

key: Which, in what is possibly the single worst-designed interface in all of human history, is done by lining up those colored blocks with the screens.
en: Which, in what is possibly the single worst-designed interface in all of human history, is done by lining up those colored blocks with the screens.
ja: それが、おそらく人類史上最悪の設計のインターフェースで、あの色付きブロックを画面とそろえることで行われるってわけ。

key: If the Amethyst gem is Small, then we push the purple block in front of the screen that says "Small."
en: If the Amethyst gem is Small, then we push the purple block in front of the screen that says "Small."
ja: アメジストが「小」なら、紫のブロックを「小」と書かれた画面の前に押す。

key: Even a Mankey could do that, but it would probably raise ethical concerns.
en: Even a Mankey could do that, but it would probably raise ethical concerns.
ja: マンキーにだってできそうだけど、たぶん倫理的な問題が出てくるでしょうね。
わかった?

key: VICTORIA: So it looks like there's a way forward, but it's gated...
en: VICTORIA: So it looks like there's a way forward, but it's gated...
ja: ヴィクトリア: 進む道はありそうだけど、閉ざされてる…

key: There'll be something to this, right?
en: There'll be something to this, right?
ja: 何か仕掛けがあるんだよね?

key: TITANIA: The way forward is locked again,
en: TITANIA: The way forward is locked again,
ja: ティタニア: 先に進む道はまた閉じてる、
当然だけど。
ティタニア: いつも何かあるわね。
「完了」

en: Skip Victory Road Gem Logic on this file?
ja: このファイルでチャンピオンロードの宝石ロジックをスキップする?

手がかりを見る
解答を確認する
説明を見直す
